items.title: Warsh Is Reverting Fed to Historic Norms, Gary Cohn Says
items.summary: IBM Vice Chairman Gary Cohn says, "the market became addicted to knowing what the Fed was going to do" as he discusses market reaction to Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's handling of the US central bank. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance."

items.title: Accenture (ACN) Expands Banking Role With UniCredit And IBM Partnership
items.summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) has agreed to a new collaboration with UniCredit and IBM to build a next generation banking platform in Europe. IBM will work on modernizing UniCredit’s technology stack as part of this multi year initiative.
